Wave, Elastic rods, 14 pieces, 2525.25 mm cut, 6.703 mm lock margin. Audit passed. Coral, Circular arcs, 14 pieces, 2494.82 mm cut, 4.828 mm lock margin. Audit passed. Matrix, Quadrilateral exchange, 14 pieces, 2663.23 mm cut, 0.094 mm lock margin. Audit passed.
